title: Masculinity, Testosterone, and Financial Misreporting

scopes.description: The assigned release contains only the online appendix for this paper. It documents supplementary empirical results, but the complete paper-wide author workflow, inputs, and outputs remain unknown from the supplied material.

requirements.description: Compatible author-prepared data and input specifications needed to reproduce the paper-wide analyses, including the supplementary appendix results; the supplied appendix does not enumerate the complete analysis inputs or establish a compatible route.

issues.description: No author program or executable workflow is supplied in this release; the assigned inventory contains only the online-appendix PDF.

The supplied online appendix reports supplemental analyses and mentions some data sources, but it does not specify the complete paper-wide analysis workflow, inputs, construction, entry points, or full output map. Those paper-level requirements cannot be inferred from this document-only release.

evidence.description: The assigned work-item inventory lists one material file, zeng-appendix.pdf, and no dependency edges; the static audit likewise reports only that PDF and no supported code.
The supplied document identifies itself as the online appendix to the titled paper.
evidence.quote: Online Appendix to: “Masculinity, Testosterone, and Financial Misreporting”

evidence.description: The appendix reports a supplementary analysis using the S&P 1500 sample and identifies a restatement source combination, illustrating that the PDF describes results rather than supplying the executable input workflow.
evidence.quote: Table OA1 shows the detailed estimation results using the S&P 1500 sample

evidence.description: The appendix enumerates additional analyses, including a 2009-only analysis and a matched restatement sample, without supplying their program or inputs.
evidence.quote: Additional analyses: replication of the results using only data from 2009 and one-to-one matched restatement sample

actions.description: Obtain the complete author replication materials and workflow specifications before defining or attempting the full paper replication scope.
steps: Request the complete paper-wide author release, including programs and all entry points, README or data documentation, author-prepared analysis inputs, and required software/version notes.
Request the authors’ mapping from each paper and appendix table/figure to its program, required inputs, generated intermediates, and actual execution order.

After the release is supplied, inventory it and reassess the dependency closure and compatible routes without treating the appendix’s historical data-source descriptions as live requirements by themselves.
validation: Confirm the supplied release includes the author programs and an entry point for every documented output, or obtain an explicit author statement describing approved non-code alternatives.
Verify each required analysis input’s fields, identifiers, period, transformations, and acquisition route against the author instructions before assigning a readiness outcome.
Only after the workflow and inputs are fully specified, prepare a future authorized run plan and verify output coverage against the paper and online appendix.

review_notes: Assessment is limited to the assigned document-only release. The appendix contains supplementary reported analyses, but its references to historical source data do not establish live dependencies or a full paper-wide workflow.
No analysis_only scope is justified: this release supplies neither author analysis code nor author-prepared analysis data with a supported compatible route.
